items.title: Tourist arrivals increase in Mustang
items.summary: Mustang, October 26 Tourist activity in the Himalayan district of Mustang has been picking up since Dashain. The district, which remained nearly deserted before the festival, has seen an increase in tourist arrivals since Thursday. items.title: Can a cricket league comfort a country in mourning?
items.summary: Nepal Premier League cannot rebuild Rasuwa, but it can give a grieving nation somewhere to gather.

items.title: Nepal resumes power exports to Bangladesh after flood disruption
items.summary: Nepal has restarted its 40MW electricity supply through India’s transmission network, using Solu Khola and Kabeli B1 to replace the flood-damaged Trishuli and Chilime hydropower plants.

items.title: Will Nepal’s lights stay on at 7pm in the winter?
items.summary: The Bhotekoshi flood and the Kaligandaki landslides exposed a grid that depends on a few valleys and on river flow. Winter evenings, when demand peaks and India’s imports stop, will show how much of Nepal’s power is dependable.
